compliance_deadlines: 15 December (12 months after publication of commitments): invited public progress reporting at an AI Pact event
Open for company signatures at any time until the EU AI Act fully applies
implementation_notes: The EU AI Pact is a non-binding initiative promoted by the European Commission and its AI Office to help stakeholders prepare during the EU AI Act transitional period (following the AI Act's entry into force on 2024-08-01). It comprises two pillars: Pillar I (an open stakeholder network for webinars and best-practice sharing) and Pillar II (voluntary company pledges, or 'declarations of engagement', launched with first signatories on 2024-09-25 and signed by over 230 companies). Core pledges cover adopting an AI governance strategy, identifying and mapping likely high-risk AI systems, and promoting staff AI literacy; additional optional pledges cover human oversight, risk mitigation, and transparency for AI-generated content such as deepfakes. Pledges carry no legal obligations or sanctions.
